# Rosemary West

## Overview

- **Age:** Mid-thirties  <sub>[v5 c2 P64](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0064), [v5 c21 P21](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0021)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P64](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0064)</sub>
- **Status:** Married  <sub>[v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)</sub>
- **Origin:** Glen St. Mary  <sub>[v5 c21 P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000)</sub>
- **Role:** Music teacher  <sub>[v5 c2 P61](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0061)</sub>

## Appearance

Rosemary West is a very beautiful woman with a high-bred, stately air and a fair complexion with pink cheeks. She has large, tranquil, companionable blue eyes and thick, golden hair, which she wears in sleek, close coils. She dresses with daintiness, often favoring frills, laces, and a touch of crimson.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P61](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0061), [v5 c2 P64](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0064), [v5 c13 P8](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0008), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009)_

## Personality

Rosemary is a sweet, gentle, and patient woman who possesses a deep capacity for love and forgiveness. Though she maintains a dignified bearing, she retains a young, delighted curiosity toward life and a warm, sympathetic nature. She is deeply loyal to her promises and loved ones, sometimes to the point of sacrificing her own happiness. Gentle and understanding, she effortlessly wins the trust and affection of children.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P64](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0064), [v5 c13 P9](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0009), [v5 c13 P10](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0010), [v5 c20 P9](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0009), [v5 c20 P16](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0016), [v5 c20 P38](../source/v05-c20.md#nw-v05-c20-p0038)_

## History

Rosemary West grew up in the Glen St. Mary area. At seventeen, her first love, Martin Crawford, was lost at sea, leaving her heartbroken. Following her mother's death years later, she made a solemn vow on her mother's Bible to her sister Ellen that she would never marry, so that Ellen would not be left alone. She lived quietly at the family homestead on a hill, giving music lessons to local children. Eventually, she met the widowed minister, John Meredith, and the two developed a deep mutual affection. When John proposed, Rosemary felt bound by her oath to Ellen and reluctantly refused him. Later, after Ellen decided to marry her own former suitor, Norman Douglas, and released Rosemary from her vow, John Meredith was encouraged by his young daughter Una to ask again. Rosemary accepted, and they were married in a double wedding alongside Ellen and Norman.

_Sources: [v5 c2 P61](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0061), [v5 c2 P63](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0063), [v5 c13 P0](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0000), [v5 c13 P5](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0005), [v5 c21 P0](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0000), [v5 c21 P20](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0020), [v5 c21 P26](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0026), [v5 c21 P30](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0030), [v5 c22 P18](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0018), [v5 c22 P41](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0041), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c32 P28](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0028), [v5 c34 P9](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0009), [v5 c34 P26](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0026), [v5 c35 P0](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0000)_
